title: Integer Replacement
goal: Solve Integer Replacement: Find minimum steps to reach 1 from n using division by 2 (if even) or add/subtract 1 (if odd).
strategy: Find minimum steps to reach 1 from n using division by 2 (if even) or add/subtract 1 (if odd).
edgeCases: Even values halve directly; odd values choose between neighboring evens, with small cases needing careful termination.
